== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Be With Me (Errata)]]: Left: the image of [[Be With Me]] (published 21 December 2021, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/bewithme.gif holotable 8190af8]); right: the image of [[Be With Me (Errata)]] (published 20 February 2023, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9e3d9929eb170ded7c439b48f806e67eb656faf7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/bewithme.gif holotable 9e3d992]). Same area (x 103–201, y 997–1039) cropped from each published image <code>bewithme.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
